title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Hosur

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office for sale in Hosur? SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel container offices, built at our Bengaluru factory in Gopasandra (560099) and delivered across Hosur and the wider Hosur–Bengaluru industrial corridor. You buy straight from the people who fabricate the unit, so the specification, finish and price are all confirmed with one team.

Hosur sits in Krishnagiri district, Tamil Nadu, roughly 40 km from Bengaluru, and its factories, warehouses and SIPCOT industrial pockets make it a natural fit for site offices, security cabins and ready-to-use workspaces. Below we cover the sizes we supply, how we build them and how delivery to Hosur works.

Container Offices for Sale in Hosur

A container office is a factory-built steel workspace on an MS frame, finished with insulated wall and roof panels, wiring points, flooring, a door and windows, then transported ready to use. SAMAN supplies 10ft, 20ft and 40ft units to Hosur — single cabins or stackable, modular layouts for site offices, commercial cabins and on-site management rooms.

Container office sizes we supply

We build three standard footprints. Each can be customised with extra windows, partitions, a toilet section, AC points or external cladding to suit how you will use it.

SizeTypical useFits
10ftSecurity cabin, single-desk site office, ticket/guard post1–2 people
20ftStandard site or commercial office, supervisor cabin3–5 people
40ftTeam office, meeting room, multi-room or stacked layout6–10+ people

Need a layout that is not listed here? We fabricate to your drawing, so the internal arrangement is built around your team and equipment.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Every unit is built on a mild-steel (MS) frame to IS 2062 structural steel standards, so the base and frame take site handling, stacking and repeated relocation. SAMAN POS India Private Limited holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, and units are fabricated in-house at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 factory — not bought in and resold.

Our coverage on every container office is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)

Standard delivery is ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days, and returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation. Buying direct means specification, build and after-sales all sit with one manufacturer.

Delivery and installation in Hosur

We deliver finished container offices from our Bengaluru (Gopasandra) factory across Bengaluru and on to Hosur and the surrounding Krishnagiri industrial belt. Because Hosur is on the Bengaluru side of the Tamil Nadu border, units travel a short, established route along the Hosur–Bengaluru corridor.

Most single units arrive ready to use and only need a level base and a power connection. Larger or stacked layouts are positioned and set on site by our team. Transit is typically 3–5 days from dispatch, depending on the size and finish you order.

Get a container office quote in Hosur

Tell us the size, layout and any extras you need and we will confirm the current price and lead time for delivery to Hosur. Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry on this page. You can also browse the full container office range to see configurations before you ask for a quote.

FAQs


What container office sizes can I buy in Hosur?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices to Hosur, as single cabins or stackable modular layouts. Each can be customised with partitions, windows, a toilet section or AC points.


How long does delivery to Hosur take?

Transit is typically 3–5 days from dispatch out of our Bengaluru (Gopasandra) factory, depending on the size and finish. Standard delivery is ₹3,000.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. We build to your requirement — internal partitions, extra windows, electrical and AC points, toilet sections and external cladding are all options on the standard footprints.


What is the warranty on a SAMAN container office?

Coverage is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How are SAMAN container offices built?

Each unit is fabricated on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, with insulated panels, flooring, wiring and joinery, by an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer at our Bengaluru factory.


How do I get a price for Hosur?

Call +91 62009 09435 or use Send Enquiry with your size and layout. We confirm the current price and lead time for delivery to Hosur — pricing is shared on enquiry.

About SAMAN — container office manufacturer

Hosur's SIPCOT industrial area on the Bengaluru–Krishnagiri belt is an auto and manufacturing hub, where container offices serve as factory site offices and supervisor cabins, delivered from our nearby Bengaluru (Gopasandra, 560099) factory.

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions) is a direct container office manufacturer — ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647) certified; NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207); DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005); Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770); GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). We build on IS 2062 steel and dispatch factory-direct from Bangalore (Gopasandra, 560099) and Greater Noida (Jalpura, 201308) with a ₹3,000 default delivery charge and typical transit of 3–5 days. Call +91 62009 09435 or send an enquiry. See our container office cabin for a factory-built unit.

Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
